definitions.explanation: Marks the location where an action takes place. {学校|がっこう}で{勉強|べんきょう}する (study at school). Compare with に, which marks location of existence.
Indicates the means, tool, or method used to do something. バスで{行|い}く (go by bus), {日本語|にほんご}で{話|はな}す (speak in Japanese).
Indicates what something is made from. {木|き}で{作|つく}る (make from wood).
Indicates the cause or reason. {病気|びょうき}で{休|やす}む (absent due to illness).
Sets a boundary or scope. {三人|さんにん}で (among three people), {一時間|いちじかん}で (within an hour).
Marks the age or circumstance at which something happens. {二十歳|はたち}で{大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}した (graduated from university at 20).

predicates_requiring.description: Action verbs take で for location (unlike existence verbs which take に)

common_actions.example: {図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}する
{会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}く
レストランで{食|た}べる

particle_contrasts.explanation: で marks location of ACTION; に marks location of EXISTENCE

examples.de_example: {図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}する
examples.de_note: で with action ({勉強|べんきょう}する)

examples.ni_example: {図書館|としょかん}に{本|ほん}がある
examples.ni_english: there are books in the library

key_points: で = where an ACTION takes place ({食|た}べる/{働|はたら}く/{勉強|べんきょう}する)
に = where something EXISTS (いる/ある/{住|す}む)
This is one of the most common particle confusions for learners

particle_contrasts.explanation: で can mark location while を marks the object

examples.combined: レストランで{寿司|すし}を{食|た}べる
examples.note: で for location, を for object

key_points: Both can appear in the same sentence
で marks where; を marks what

fixed_patterns.example: {京都|きょうと}は{お寺|おてら}で{有名|ゆうめい}です
コーヒーでも{飲|の}みませんか
fixed_patterns.example_english: Would you like to have some coffee or something?

fixed_patterns.example: {全部|ぜんぶ}で{三千円|さんぜんえん}です
{木|き}で{机|つくえ}を{作|つく}る

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}します。
{電車|でんしゃ}で{行|い}きましょう。
{英語|えいご}で{書|か}いてください。
{風邪|かぜ}で{学校|がっこう}を{休|やす}みました。
examples.english: I was absent from school due to a cold.

examples.japanese: {三人|さんにん}でこの{仕事|しごと}をしました。
examples.english: Three of us did this work.

common_mistakes.mistake: Using に instead of で for action location
common_mistakes.incorrect: {図書館|としょかん}に{勉強|べんきょう}する
common_mistakes.correct: {図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}する
common_mistakes.explanation: Use で (not に) for where actions take place

common_mistakes.mistake: Using で instead of に for existence
common_mistakes.explanation: Use に (not で) for location with いる/ある

common_mistakes.mistake: Using で instead of に for destination
common_mistakes.explanation: Use に for destination; で can mark means ({電車|でんしゃ}で{行|い}く)

notes: で vs に is crucial: で marks where actions happen ({図書館|としょかん}で{勉強|べんきょう}する), while に marks where things exist ({図書館|としょかん}に{本|ほん}がある) or destinations ({図書館|としょかん}に{行|い}く). で is one of the most versatile particles, covering location, means, material, cause, and scope.
